module: Internal tool for automatically generating vehicle performance sheets (files vehicles/<model>/info_<config>.json), driven from the GE by util_saveDynamicData. A coroutine runs static measurements (weight, power, torque, peak RPMs, engine type, induction, fuel, transmission, layout, bounding box) then dynamic ones (accelerations, braking, off-road score) by repositioning the vehicle, then updates the info file by recursive merge.
notes: Keys written in the info file: Weight (kg rounded to 5), PowerPeakRPM, TorquePeakRPM ('min - max' range if the gap exceeds 500 RPM, values rounded to 50), Torque (N·m rounded to 5), Power (rounded), Weight/Power, Propulsion (Electric, ICE, Hybrid, Other), Induction Type (NA, Turbo, SC, N2O and combinations; only for ICE/Hybrid), Fuel Type (Gasoline, Diesel, Battery, Hybrid, ...), Transmission, Drivetrain (layout), BoundingBox (two points: min and max relative to the ref node), Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-200 km/h, 0-300 km/h, 100-200 km/h, 0-60 mph, 0-100 mph, 0-200 mph, 60-100 mph, 100-0 km/h, 60-0 mph, Braking G, Off-Road Score.

Before each write, the whitelist keys are erased from the existing file, then the new values are merged (tableMergeRecursive); compareData warns in the log if a numeric value changes by more than 10%.

The dynamic tests depend on the GE: be:resetVehicle(0), setPositionRotation and autoplace on player 0's vehicle, with 2 s waits. updateGFX resumes the coroutine every frame, sends a heartbeat to the GE and triggers util_saveDynamicData.vehicleDone() at the end.
The braking test is only run if the vehicle was able to reach 115 km/h during the accelerations.
For vehicles without an engine (category engine), only the Weight key is recorded by the static performance data.
performTests does not check for the presence of wheels: the acceleration tests stop if wheels.wheelCount <= 0.
getPowertrainLayout is exported and returns a string describing the layout ('Other' by default, depending on the detected driven wheels).

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: increments the internal timer, resumes the test coroutine and sends the heartbeat/killswitch to the GE.

performTests.desc: Launches the complete sequence (static data then dynamic tests) in a coroutine for the indicated model and configuration.

getPowertrainLayout.desc: Determines the vehicle's transmission layout from the driven wheels (text value, 'Other' if undetermined).
